instruction.task: Implement Phase 1, Slice 2 of the Agency Command Center ERP.
instruction.objective: Establish the "Core Business Entity" by linking standardized Scope Templates to active Client Onboarding, enabling the transition from sales to operational execution.

section.title: 1. Scope Template Engine (Module 2.3)
section.requirement: Implement the Scope Template schema. Use JSONB for 'default_tasks' (grouped by Month/Milestone) and 'kpi_framework' to allow for schema flexibility per industry.
Seed the database with the 7+ mandatory industries (Real Estate, SaaS, E-commerce, etc.) and their specific service types as defined in the PRD.

section.title: 2. Client Onboarding (Module 2.2)
section.requirement: Create the onboarding form. - Left: Metadata (Contact info, Monthly Retainer, Currency). - Right: Template Selector with a live 'Task Preview' from the selected blueprint.
Implement auto-calculation logic: contract_end = contract_start + duration_months. (AC-07).
Implement the high-level sortable table displaying Name, Industry, Service Type, and Status (Active/Paused/Completed).

section.title: 3. The Operational Trigger
section.requirement: On successful Client creation, the system must automatically generate the 'Month 1' Workflow record linked to that client, pulling task data from the assigned template.
Automatically link the creating User (if PM/Admin) as the 'pm_id' for the Client and its initial Workflow.

logic.description: Atomic Transactions: Client creation and the generation of the first Workflow shell must be atomic. Fail the entire process if the Workflow shell cannot be instantiated.
Data Snapshotting: When creating a Workflow from a Template, COPY the data. Do not link. If a Template is updated later, it must not retroactively change a Client's active tasks.
Role Enforcement: Restrict Client creation (POST) to 'super_admin' and 'project_manager' roles only as established in Slice 1.

instruction.first_principles_check: The "Entity Boundary" check: Does a Client exist without an assigned Template? No. Does a Client exist without a PM owner? No. This slice ensures the system remains a rigid 'System of Record' for agency operations.
